Prepared `work/h22_test_restart_audit.py`, coordinated against the builder's `hala.h22.test_restart_amendment.v1` contract. It requires an explicit external amendment file/SHA and explicitly qualified expected GPU UUID; `PENDING_ACTUAL_QUALIFICATION` is rejected. The old auditor remains byte-identical at SHA256 `a816cde40e58b361f7143e5adb165006a877b5a9c39ef9b88540a59e05d1a09f`. No frozen production source, old auditor, experiment input or raw record was edited.

The amendment must bind attempt 3, exact source07591/freeze98ca, original adapter/data/package/budget identities, only FP16/int8/NF4 TEST profiles, prior DEV manifest `60a0986cc196041c2474314624e0f88c9c2986d75bc58cf0ddb44623ed294e02`, and the exact three immutable DEV retention identities. Local index0/1/2 maps explicitly to original logical index3/4/5. The wrapper compares actual record UUID/mode/split and bound comparison metadata to those expectations without rewriting the record. Archived experiment bytes must hash to the externally supplied public amendment SHA, and profile/qualification records must agree with attempt3 and the new UUID. All published identity inputs remain caller-supplied external expectations; this script does not infer publication from local filenames.

The new script contains a copied independent stdlib scoring/geometry/cost core from the immutable previous auditor. Its actual-record checks are unchanged apart from receiving the expected UUID as an explicit parameter instead of a fixed attempt2 constant; expected logical order is passed separately. Strict H19 JSON/semantics, persisted-state replay, pixel/hash bindings, package/source checks, quantized/vision storage, cost arithmetic and null handling are preserved. It imports only the independent H21 stdlib audit helper, with no production or ML imports. `--source-repo`, `--bundle` and `--adapter` are explicit portable overrides; defaults derive from this script's workspace, not a personal absolute path.

Eight stdlib tests pass via `rtk proxy python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s work -p test_h22_test_restart_audit.py -v`. Meaningful negative tests use the real saved FP16 DEV record unchanged: it is rejected for TEST split even when expected UUID/mode match, and independently rejects wrong expected UUID and mode. Other tests reject pending/mismatched external UUID, changed source/freeze/DEV identity/profile groups/adoption flags and wrong amendment SHA; they verify index mapping, syntax and unchanged old auditor SHA. Synthetic UUIDs are only configuration fixtures. No fake TEST-success record, actual TEST outcome count, model execution or tuning was created.
No actual restart audit can run before the new public amendment SHA, qualified UUID and retained raw result/ZIP hashes arrive. Example with actual future values:

rtk proxy python -X utf8 work/h22_test_restart_audit.py PATH_TO_EXTRACTED/run/result.json --archive PATH_TO_RAW.zip --result-sha256 ACTUAL_RESULT_SHA --archive-sha256 ACTUAL_ARCHIVE_SHA --amendment PATH_TO_PUBLISHED_AMENDMENT.json --amendment-sha256 PUBLIC_AMENDMENT_SHA --expected-gpu-uuid ACTUALLY_QUALIFIED_UUID --index 0 --source-repo PATH_TO_SOURCE_REPO --bundle PATH_TO_H19_BUNDLE --adapter PATH_TO_RETAINED_ADAPTER --output PATH_TO_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.json

Output always leaves adoption/quality/native/execution false. Exceptions or identity mismatches cannot produce complete success or fabricated counters. The new TEST hardware group cannot establish a same-device cost comparison with the completed DEV group. Power sensors remain uncalibrated; no energy/efficiency/monetary conclusion follows. Repeated standalone probes remain exposed diagnostics. No TEST-failure tuning or source/parser relaxation is authorized by this preparation.

# H22 TEST-only restart — independent combined operator review

Scope: new TEST-only operator, qualification helper, draft amendment, builder handoff and focused operator tests. No production-phase source audit repeated. No GPU, inference, model download, network fetch, source edit or publication by reviewer.

Must fix: none. Worth considering: none for the fixed trusted-operator workflow. The amendment's deliberate GPU placeholder remains an execution blocker until actual qualification and external publication of the final manifest identity.

- Only local indices0..2 exist, fixed to fp16/int8/nf4 TEST. No DEV mode or automatic advance is reachable from the profile CLI. Frozen source07591, freeze98ca, original H19/model/font/retained-adapter/package/budget fields are preserved and checked against the original immutable SHA-bound study manifest. Clean complete Git source is checked before imports/launch as previously reviewed.

- First TEST requires all three fixed original DEV receipts and actual public raw ZIPs from original group `60a0986c...`, with pinned commits/receipt/archive hashes. Each passes the existing complete provenance/raw-result checks; confirmed DEV receipts enter the first new ZIP. The locally retained actual DEV ZIP bytes independently matched all three fixed archive hashes and satisfied these checks in the focused suite. Public retrieval itself occurs in the real gate, not this review.

- Later TEST requires the immediately prior new TEST receipt and actual ZIP under the distinct TEST path/SHA. Group/index checks prevent negative, boolean, out-of-range or wrong-group selection; DEV additionally requires its original SHA. Actual raw result hash/source/freeze/mode/split/status and terminal outcomes remain checked. Finished measured evidence additionally requires returncode0 and the experiment GPU UUID. No missing/forged raw-result bypass found in this delta.

- Qualification binds actual newly observed GPU UUID, real provider, original exact imports/bundle/font/retained archive and UUID-bound sampler without model loading. Placeholder UUID is rejected by amendment admission; qualification mismatch rejects before profile output/process creation. The root must publish the final postqualification amendment SHA and commit before inference.

- Each invocation launches one fresh bounded3700-second process, preserves terminal failure/timeout evidence, and exclusively creates profile directory/ZIP. Rerun prevention remains scoped to the trusted operator's retained working directory. Original DEV and new TEST remain separate physical-hardware groups; cross-group matched-device cost claims are explicitly unqualified.

- Operational reuse/copying is proportionate here: old immutable operators/manifests and DEV evidence are preserved, while separate paths/attempt identity avoid retroactively changing the completed study group.

`python -m unittest discover -s outputs -p test_h22*operator.py -q`: 16 tests passed in0.408 seconds. Covers all3 old DEV prerequisites, actual retained DEV ZIP compatibility, TEST-only invocation/no overwrite, dirty source rejection, wrong GPU/missing DEV blocking before output, and missing/forged raw evidence. Five additional direct CPU cases confirmed wrong group, index0, boolean index, index4 and wrong DEV SHA reject before network.
